Package com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model.Player
public class Player extends Object
Represents a player in the Haunted House game. Keeps track of where the player is, what items they are carrying, and their current stats.
Version:
2026.02.05
Author:
Brian Tripp
